criteria.description: Empty-input polls display Still Running with the actual command resolved from matching visible call/result execution metadata, never program stdout.
Retained invocations display Running stored script with source resolved through existing retained-script storage.
Unavailable source displays command unavailable; nonempty write_stdin input remains Send input.
Excerpts use the first command line, skip directives and wrappers, and fit 120 Unicode characters including an ellipsis for truncation or omitted lines.
JSON and SSE behavior, child-to-parent routing, delivery order, deduplication, execution, validation and replay payloads remain unchanged.
Focused tests and affected display documentation cover the requested behavior.

preparation: bun install --cwd plugins --frozen-lockfile && bun build plugins/tools.ts --outfile ./internal/router/toolplugin/dist/tools.js --production --target node --format esm --external hpatch:core/v1 --external mekugi:core/v1 && go mod download
